description: This PHP class 'EmployeeReportToController' manages the employee report-to relationships in the OrangeHRM system, handling permission checks, data preparation for views, and interaction with the reporting method configuration service.

classes.name: EmployeeReportToController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing 'report-to' relationships for employees, including rendering view components, permission checks, and retrieval of reporting methods.

methods.name: getReportingMethodConfigurationService
methods.description: Initializes and returns the ReportingMethodConfigurationService instance used to fetch reporting methods.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and components for rendering the employee report-to view based on the request; handles permissions and data fetching.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups ('supervisor', 'subordinates') used for capability/permission validation.
